summary: The recorded base reproduces both out-of-range failure and silent in-range wrong-row access when DCP-widened logical MLA indices reach the rank-local physical buffer. The exact candidate localizes indices on both backup and restore, passes failing-before/passing-after regression coverage, independent adversarial cases, and a real gfx950 numerical gather/restore check. Full TP8/DCP8 Kimi-K3 serving reproduction was unavailable.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before control of the candidate regression on the recorded base: DCP backup and restore cases failed at the unlocalized physical gather; DCP=1 passed (2 failed, 1 passed).
Independent negative-control harness confirmed the expected out-of-range exception and silent in-range wrong-row behavior on the base, plus DCP=1 identity.
Candidate regression: owner selection/localization, chunking, restore into new logical locations, and DCP=1 identity (3 passed).
Independent adversarial verification of out-of-range prevention, silent in-range correctness, new-location restore, chunking, and DCP=1 identity.
Real GPU numerical backup to CPU and restore into new DCP-widened locations on AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950; copied/restored values matched an explicit reference.

gpu_execution.evidence: candidate-gpu.log records PASS on AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950:sramecc+:xnack- with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. This is a single-rank tensor-path check, not the reported B300 multi-rank workload.

remaining_limitations: Only one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU was available; the reported environment uses 8 NVIDIA B300 GPUs with TP8/DCP8.
Kimi-K3 weights and the PD-disaggregated DSPARK/ReplaySSM serving deployment were unavailable, so capacity-triggered retract_decode was not exercised end to end.
The observed base exception used CPU tensors; the reported NVIDIA CUDA device-side assert was not reproduced on this architecture.
The candidate changes only Python source, so no native rebuild was applicable.
